A '''hepatizon chestplate''' is a [[Armor#Chestplate|chestplate]] of the [[Hepatizon equipment|hepatizon]] tier, made by smithing a [[copper chestplate]] with [[hepatizon alloy]]. Like every hepatizon piece, it makes the wearer run faster.

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade needs no template, and enchantments on the copper item carry over.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
It gives 8 armor with 500 durability and adds 0.01 to movement speed, 10% of the player's base speed. The full set gives 20 armor and 40% more speed; the [[Hepatizon Laurel|hepatizon laurel]] alone adds 0.1, doubling the base speed.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Copper|blocks of copper}}. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

It keeps the copper armor item ID, so a [[blast furnace]] melts it into one copper ingot.

=== Trading ===
An apprentice [[weaponsmith]] buys it for one [[hepatizon alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/hepatizon_chestplate.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|1.10|Renamed from "Bronze" in the language file only, so existing items keep working. Hepatizon equipment was buffed. A [[weaponsmith]] now takes the item back in exchange for its alloy, so players can rebuild it with updated stats.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer needs a base-metal item in the template slot, and the upgrade keeps the base item's enchantments. Added the "Repaired with" tooltip.}}
{{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older copies can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>.}}
